title: Ageing and population density in Utrecht
summary: Explores Utrecht neighbourhoods that combine a high share of residents aged 65+ with high population density.
question: Which Utrecht neighbourhoods combine a high share of residents aged 65+ with high population density?
interpretation: The index averages the two within-Utrecht percentile ranks with equal weights. A high mean indicates a high combined rank. One high component also raises the mean, so inspect both values in the dashboard.
limitations: This is a descriptive index, not a health-risk or care-demand estimate.
Live source updates can change ranks. The geographic filter and missing-value rules affect the comparison.
